hardware.variant: Assembled kit; V1.2 reported by operator; ESP32-S31 silicon revision 0.0 read through UART

inputs.name: USB-UART bridge enumerated as FT232R; operator confirmed 3.3 V logic

scenario: Connect only crossed TX/RX and common ground between H1 and the USB-UART adapter; supply board power separately through USB-C. Enter ROM manually with BOOT held during power-on. Run esptool with --chip esp32s31 --baud 115200 --before no-reset --after no-reset --no-stub --connect-attempts 2 chip-id on the adapter serial port. Compare the returned MAC privately with the earlier USB ROM readback identity.
expected: A valid ROM response identifying the same board through the UART adapter, establishing communication in both directions without firmware or eFuse writes.
observed: esptool exited 0, identified ESP32-S31 revision 0.0 and a 40 MHz crystal. The chip-id command reported that S31 has no chip ID and returned its MAC instead. That identity matched the earlier USB ROM readback. The board was left in the ROM loader.
limits: This verifies UART ROM request/response only, not an EmberBSD or OpenSBI console, an OS boot, a firmware write or a restore.
Board revision and adapter logic level were reported by the operator; BaseBoard marking and signal voltage were not independently measured.
Device identifiers, personal photographs and raw logs are not published.
UART log readability and sustained-transfer reliability are outside this check.
